title: Constraints on the Hot Circumgalactic Medium Around Nearby L* Galaxies from the SRG/eROSITA All Sky Survey
summary: Stacked eROSITA observations reveal diffuse X-ray emission around nearby L∗ galaxies and constrain the thermal state and radial distribution of the hot CGM.

authors: Yuxuan Zou, Feng Yuan, Suoqing Ji, Lin He, Zhiyuan Li, Yi Zhang, Johan Comparat, Zhijie Qu, and Taotao Fang
title: A Systematic Study of AGN Feedback in a Disk Galaxy Using MACER. II. Predictions of X-Ray Surface Brightness Profiles and Comparison with eROSITA Observations
Discovery of Giant Bubbles in the Hot Gaseous Halo of the Massive Disk Galaxy NGC 6286
authors: Lin He, Zhiyuan Li, Zongnan Li, Rubén García-Benito, Yuanqi Liu, and Meicun Hou
summary: Multiwavelength observations reveal giant bubbles linked to a galactic superwind. The current starburst can power the outflow; past AGN activity remains a possible contributor.

title: Probing the Hot Gaseous Halo of the Low-mass Disk Galaxy NGC 7793 with eROSITA and Chandra
authors: Lin He, Zhiyuan Li, Meicun Hou, Min Du, Taotao Fang, and Wei Cui
summary: Evidence for extraplanar hot gas in a low-mass disk galaxy provides a test of feedback and hot-halo predictions from cosmological simulations.

title: X-Ray Constraints on the Hot Gaseous Corona of Edge-on Late-type Galaxies in Virgo
authors: Meicun Hou, Lin He, Zhensong Hu, Zhiyuan Li, Christine Jones, William Forman, Yuanyuan Su, Jing Wang, and Luis C. Ho
summary: Chandra observations constrain hot coronae in Virgo disk galaxies and the interplay of star formation and the cluster environment.

title: Robust Detection of Hot Intragroup Medium in Optically Selected, Poor Galaxy Groups by eROSITA
authors: Dawei Li, Taotao Fang, Chong Ge, Teng Liu, Lin He, Zhiyuan Li, Fabrizio Nicastro, Xiaohu Yang, Xiaoxia Zhang, and Yun-Liang Zheng
summary: Stacked eROSITA data reveal hot intragroup gas in optically selected poor groups, while a baryon deficit persists.

title: A Chandra X-Ray Survey of Optically Selected Close Galaxy Pairs: Unexpectedly Low Occupation of Active Galactic Nuclei
authors: Lin He, Meicun Hou, Zhiyuan Li, Shuai Feng, and Xin Liu
summary: An X-ray survey of 92 close galaxy pairs finds that close interaction alone is not sufficient to trigger strong nuclear activity.
